lastCompletedStory.title: Rewrite /cam-spec persist final step to pipe JSON into cam spec --persist (both copies)

nextStoryContext: All userStories in this PRD (US-001, US-002) now have passes:true. This was the last story of CAM-213: the /cam-spec 'Final step: persist the spec' now pipes { spec, wsjf, blockedBy? } JSON into `cam spec --persist <id>` via a single-quoted heredoc (mirroring the existing --write-docs safe-quoting prose), documents the CAM_SPEC_RESULT handback contract, and the error-handling table's diverged/detached-head row now points at the CLI's own CAM_SPEC_RESULT=ERROR reason=<reason> line instead of 'the guard error from specifyIssueOnMain'. Both copies (.claude/commands/cam-spec.md and templates/commands/cam-spec.md) are byte-identical; src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated via bun run embed-vendor and embed-vendor:check is clean. The separate 'Final step: persist the domain docs' (cam spec --write-docs) section was left untouched per the PRD's decision A (persist and write-docs are two pipes). Next agent invocation should find no non-operator passes:false stories and emit PRD_COMPLETE so the orchestrator runs /cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure prompt-doc rewrite (markdown prose + a bash heredoc pipe into the already-implemented, already-tested cam spec --persist CLI from US-001). No new external dependency or library API surface touched.
